title: Windows fixed-work EW render getters and retained native frame attempts

qualification.scope: Finite authored native CPU workload and focused semantic checks. Both failed frame cohorts remain evidence; their individual frame summaries do not establish a comparative FPS result.

publication.raw_capture_encoding: Each raw text field is decoded from original bytes as UTF-8 without newline conversion. Re-encoding it as UTF-8 reproduces the recorded byte count and SHA-256, including CRLF.
publication.source_roles: Repository paths are relative role names. Toolchain and private executable directories become roles. Normalized command projections are distinct from exact raw stdout and stderr.
publication.omissions: No environment dump, imported asset inventory or payload, save payload, original game class or personal absolute path is published. Native scalar work checkpoints and authored camera summaries are retained. Private source reports are bound by exact file hashes.
publication.source_guard_manifest_encoding: The manifest key is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators. Each manifest maps normalized source or product roles to their captured SHA-256 values.

source_scope.candidate: Uncommitted candidate inputs are identified by the captured role manifests and actual product hashes; no later commit or CI result is implied.
source_scope.baseline_execution_guard_caveat: The new baseline processes execute the retained 9421 build while their execution guards snapshot the current selected source files. Those guard snapshots prove continuity during execution, not that the old executable was built from the current candidate sources. Separate baseline build-library bindings and the earlier baseline capture remain included.
source_scope.scene: The frame runner uses its authored native Tiny sky-view scenario and camera settings. This is not a claim of an original game whole-scene reference or pixel identity.

fixed_work_cpu.scope:
Compare fixed-work EW render getters and retain every CPU attempt.

Matching Release binaries must use one shared workload object. Measurements
compare public complete diagnostics with internal failure-only diagnostics;
they do not measure scene FPS or establish new original-game parity.
fixed_work_cpu.input_hash_scope: Execution continuity, not binary build provenance.

source_and_product_guard.retained_map_digest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators; original private keys are hashed but not published.

fixed_work_cpu.timing_scope: Only the actual typed getter call loop is timed. Authoring, normalization, assertions, snapshots, hashes, fault controls and cleanup are outside timing. Layout byte sizes are not a measured memory-traffic count.
fixed_work_cpu.brightness_effect: Plain and minimum brightness may set the real shared Chunk positive-SkyLight flag. Each sample has an explicit paired precondition with that flag clear, verifies the genuine effect, then restores it only outside timing. Other guarded owners and state remain unchanged.
